translation.name: Ilagano lya Katali, Ilagano Linyale kwa Wanhu Weng’ha

content: Paoli na Banaba ako Ikonio

Kula Ikonio, mbuli zali kota vyozali kula Antiokiya, Paoli na Banaba nawaluta kuli ng'handa ya kusalila ya Wayahudi nakudamla goya na wala wawele Wayahudi wenji na Wagilichi wawa wanhu walingumkunda Kilistu.
Ila Wayahudi wanji walemile kuwa wanhu wa Nguluwi nawawatumajiza na kiviluchila muli nhumbula ya wanhu hawawele Wayahudi leka wawalemele awo wanhu wa lukolo lumwe.
Paoli na Banaba nawekala ako mhela uhejile. Nawaweza kulonga ga Mkulu, na Mkulu katawiza ng'hatu luzi loyaulavile kwa mbuli ya kunoga kwa heye, na kudita vinduzanduza na kububuwaza.
Wanhu wa isi ayo nawesambaluka, wanji nawawalumba moko Wayahudi, na wamwe wali ubanzi wa watumigwa.
Hamba, wanhu hawawele Wayahudi na Wayahudi, wochitanza na wakulu wa hewo, nawagana kuwaditila vibi awo watumigwa na kuwatowa na maganga.
Watumigwa lowavizelele mbuli ayo, nawabilimila Lustila na Delibe, Miji ja Lukaonia, na honhu hanji ha habehi.
Wazangudamla Mbuli Inojile ako.
Paoli na Banaba ako Lustila na Delibe
Kwali na munhu yumwe ako Lustila nayali chete kulawila loyavumbuche nayali hanajenda nehado.
Munhu ayo nayali yomhulichiza Paoli loyali yodamla. Paoli kazangumlola goya, na loyawene yawele na makundo ga kusilwa utamwa,
nakayowa, “Winuche wime kwa magulu gako!” Ayo munhu nayali chete wa magulu, baho nakenuka, nakaluka kujenda.
Wanhu wenji lowawene choyaditile Paoli, nawaluka kuyoweleza kwa ulonzi wa Chilukonia, “Milungu jituyila kwa meho ga wanhu!”
Banaba nakachemigwa Seusi, na Paoli nakachemigwa Helime, kwa vila heye ndo nayali yolonga.

Na heye mtambika wa ng'handa ya milungu ja Seusi nayali hanze ha muji kegala isenga ibuguma na nganda za uluwa hali chihindilo chikulu cha muji, heye na wala wanhu weng'ha wazangugana kuwatambichila watumigwa.
Banaba na Paoli lowahuliche ago, nawavula na kudeganga mivalo ja hewo na kubilimila kuli wala wanhu, wolonga kwa lizi likulu,

“Wang'holozangu, lekachoni muli ngudita mbuli azi? Na hetwe twayenu twa wanhu kota mwemwe. Twahano kuwadamlila Mbuli Inojile, mjileche aji jimalukolo, mumgalamchile Nguluwi yawele mkomu, Nguluwi yalumbile ulanga na isi, bahali na vinhu vyeng'ha vili mumo.
Katali Nguluwi nakawaleka wanhu wadite kota vila vyowaganile.

Ahyo Nguluwi halechile kilajila kwa mbuli zinojile zoyalinguwaditila, kanguwatowela nhonya kulawa kilanga, kanguwagalila mbena mhela wa mbena, kanguwagalila chilyo na kuzimemeza nhumbula za hemwe usangalalo.”
Hanga nawalonga ahyo na haiwele ubewe kuwalemeza wanhu waleche kuwatambichila.
Ila Wayahudi wamwe nawoya kulawila Ikonio na Antiokiya mu isi ya Pisidiya, wawadita wanhu welongoze na heye, wamtowa maganga Paoli na kumbulunha mbaka hanze ha muji wochijesa mina nakabagama.
Ila walanguswa lowekungajize na kumzunguluta, nakenuka na kuhiluka kuli muji. Mitondo yake, heye hamwe na Banaba nawaluta Delibe.
Paoli na Banaba wanguhiluka mjini Antiokiya ako Siliya
Paoli na Banaba lowadamle Mbuli Inojile ako Delibe na wanhu wenji kuwawinza, nawenula majendo kuza Antiokiya kwa kukolela Lustila na Ikonio.
Nawawakangaza wanhu walingumkunda Kilistu na kuwahimiliza wapone muli makundo. Nawawalonjela, “Itugana hetwe tweng'ha kukolela mli magazo menji leka twinjile mli Undewa wa Nguluwi.”

Nawawahagula wasekulu mli chila chilundo cha wanhu walingumkunda Kilistu kwa mbuli ya wanhu wa Nguluwi, hamba kwa kumlanda Nguluwi na kwesela kulya, nawawawika hali wamizi wa Mkulu yula wawele womkunda.
Lowakolile mli isi ya Pisidiya, nawafika Pamfiliya.
Lowadamle ula usenga ako Pega, nawaluta Ataliya.
Kulawa ako nawaheluka kwa itumbwi nawahiluka Antiokiya kula aho hamwaluko wali wawichilwe mli wamizi wa Isungu lya Nguluwi kwa mijito ila sambi mina ikoleka.

Lowafichile ako Antiokiya nawadita nhing'hano na chilundo cha wanhu walingumkunda Kilistu cha hala, nawawalonjela geng'ha Nguluwi nagoyaditile hamwe na hewo, na vyoyawachumulile wanhu hawawele Wayahudi kwinjila mli makundo.
Nawekala na wala walanguswa kwa mhela uhejile.
